label: Serotonin plus histamine/muscarinic aminergic receptor signalling
reason: Serotonin synthesis, uptake and receptor signalling dominate; histamine and muscarinic ACh receptors join as fellow aminergic class-A GPCRs coupling to Gi/Gq.

label: Hindbrain/cerebellar development and motor behaviour
reason: Cerebellum, pons, brainstem and basal ganglia development with motor learning, locomotion and proprioception form one motor-system theme; neural RNA-binding BTM fits.

label: ER-Golgi-endosome secretory membrane trafficking
reason: COPI/COPII, ER targeting, Golgi organisation, endosome-Golgi and lysosomal sorting dominate; a few odd members (Rhotekin, UFMylation, Ral) are a small minority.

label: Germline and spermatogenesis chromatin programmes
reason: Spermatogenesis, piRNA silencing, PGC specification, protamine exchange and ZGA form a germ cell/early embryo theme; lncRNA transcription and mRNA export are minor outliers.

label: Platelet activation and aggregation
reason: GPVI, GPIb-IX-V, P2Y1/P2Y12, degranulation and coagulation are all platelet activation.

label: NGF/TrkA and p75NTR neurotrophin signalling
reason: All members are NGF processing, TrkA downstream cascades (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, PI3K, CREB) or p75NTR death signalling.

label: Renal water/sodium balance via RAAS and vasopressin
reason: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone and vasopressin/aquaporin control of urine volume, sodium excretion and blood pressure is one fluid-homeostasis axis.

label: Neuroendocrine control of feeding, growth, stress
reason: Leptin/ghrelin appetite control, GH/prolactin/somatostatin and HPA cortisol secretion are linked as hypothalamic-pituitary endocrine regulation of energy balance.

label: Golgi organisation and endosome-Golgi vesicle traffic
reason: All members concern Golgi structure, COPI traffic, TGN sorting and endosome-Golgi-lysosome transport.

label: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, transport, degradation
reason: Catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis, SLC6 uptake, vesicular loading and MAO/COMT degradation, with sympathoadrenal development; histamine receptors a lone outlier.

label: Actin dynamics driving cell protrusion and motility
reason: Arp2/3 nucleation, severing, capping, bundling, lamellipodia, ruffles and podosomes are all actin-based motility.

label: Purine and pyrimidine nucleotide metabolism
reason: De novo synthesis, salvage, interconversion and catabolism of (deoxy)ribonucleotides throughout.

label: Mitotic centrosome maturation, AURKA/PLK1 regulation
reason: Centrosome protein recruitment, NEK9/6/7, AURKA-TPX2, PLK1 at G2/M and spindle assembly form one mitotic entry theme.

label: Epithelial cell junctions, adhesion and EMT
reason: Adherens, tight junctions, desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, polarity and EMT dominate; adrenomedullin, indole-3-methanol and cardiac AP are small outliers.

label: Viral replication cycle and host interactions
reason: Entry, replication, transcription, translation, integration and host restriction for HIV, influenza, RSV, CMV and coronaviruses.

label: Notch and Hedgehog signalling with ligand processing
reason: Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR share gamma-secretase intramembrane proteolysis; Hedgehog joins via autoprocessing and palmitoylation of the ligand - protein-processing-activated developmental signalling.

label: Amino acid catabolism and associated cofactors
reason: Serine, threonine, proline, histidine, tyrosine/phenylalanine and sulfur amino acid metabolism with their cofactors (PLP, BH4, MoCo); DNA protection is an outlier.

label: LDL receptor endocytosis and cholesterol uptake
reason: LDLR/VLDLR internalisation, clearance and sterol-regulated uptake with general receptor endocytosis/recycling regulation.

label: Nucleoside/nucleotide transport and interconversion
reason: ENT-mediated nucleoside transport (incl. abacavir, ribavirin), mitochondrial ADP/ATP carriers and NDP/NTP interconversion share nucleotide handling; Vpr-ANT MOMP fits via ANT.

label: Type 2 immunity: Th2, eosinophils, mast cells
reason: Th2 differentiation, IL-5 production, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation/activation form one allergic-type immune axis.

label: tRNA processing and mitochondrial RNA maturation
reason: Nuclear tRNA processing joins mitochondrial transcript processing via shared tRNA end-processing (RNase P/Z) and the tRNA-punctuated mitochondrial transcript.

label: Nociception, thermosensation and itch via TRP/tachykinins
reason: Pain detection, TRP channels, tachykinin signalling, itch and thermoception are sensory-afferent nociceptor biology; micturition and fever fit via TRPV1 afferents.

label: Neural control of sensorimotor and social behaviour
reason: Locomotion, startle/prepulse inhibition, glycinergic inhibition, proprioception, vocal and social behaviour are organismal neurobehaviour; a few brain-development terms fit.

label: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signalling
reason: RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA, IRF3 and NF-kB activation and their regulators form one cytosolic antiviral pathway.

label: Mitochondrial gene expression and translation
reason: Mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing/modification, ribosome assembly and translation initiation/elongation/termination.

label: NF-kB activation, canonical and non-canonical
reason: NIK/non-canonical NF-kB, IKK complex deficiencies, CD40/TNFSF and TCR/BCR-driven NF-kB activation.

label: Myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte haematopoiesis
reason: Lineage commitment and differentiation of myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic progenitors under RUNX1/TAL1-GFI1B control; a couple of generic terms are minor.

label: Pol I/III transcription, rRNA processing, translation initiation
reason: Pol I/III transcription and rRNA processing build ribosomes and tRNAs, linked specifically to translation initiation as the protein-synthesis capacity axis.

label: tRNA and rRNA modification and processing
reason: Methylation, pseudouridylation and processing of tRNA/rRNA (cytosolic and mitochondrial), including snoRNP assembly and wybutosine synthesis.

label: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron and gas transport
reason: Heme biosynthesis, iron homeostasis, hemoglobin O2/CO2 exchange and RhAG ammonium transport are erythrocyte biology.

label: Adrenergic regulation of smooth muscle contraction
reason: Alpha/beta adrenoceptor signalling, Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition and vascular, uterine and urogenital smooth muscle contraction/relaxation.

label: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance
reason: Microglia differentiation/activation, DAP12 signalling, efferocytosis and amyloid-beta responses form a TREM2-like neuroinflammatory phagocytosis theme.

label: BMP/Nodal signalling in vascular development
reason: BMP/Nodal ligand regulation and extracellular sequestration link to endothelial specification and vessel morphogenesis via BMP9/ALK1-type TGF-beta superfamily signalling.

label: Vascular tone and blood pressure via NO/cGMP
reason: Smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, NO-cGMP, natriuretic and endothelin regulation of systemic and lung blood pressure.

label: Fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine and ketogenesis
reason: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation steps, carnitine synthesis/shuttle and ketone body synthesis/use; GLUT1 deficiency is a lone outlier.

label: Methyl, sulfur and selenium compound metabolism
reason: Choline/TMA oxidation by FMO, selenium methylation and transsulfuration are linked through methionine-cycle methyl group and sulfur/selenium amino acid metabolism.

label: Dendritic spine and postsynaptic plasticity
reason: Spine morphogenesis, postsynaptic density, LTP/LTD, reelin signalling and dendrite arborisation are all postsynaptic structural plasticity.

label: ERK inactivation and IL-6/STAT3 signalling
reason: ERK1/2 activation and phosphatase-mediated negative feedback joined to IL-6/JAK-STAT3, which activates ERK via gp130-SHP2 and is likewise phosphatase-limited.

label: Vitamin D, phosphate and bone mineralisation
reason: Vitamin D activation/catabolism, PTH, FGF23-Klotho-FGFR1c and phosphate responses regulate bone mineralisation.

label: Oncogenic RTK mutants and TKI resistance
reason: FLT3, KIT, PDGFR, ALK, ERBB2, FGFR mutants/fusions and TKI resistance dominate; EPO/TPO/IL-3 STAT5 signalling is a smaller, related haematopoietic subset.
